title: Picker's colors doesn't match the rest of app
symptom: The picker's colors do not match the rest of the app, specifically the OK/cancel button color and the selected item background color.
fix: A PR was made to fix the OK/cancel button color, but the selected item background color was left as default Material Theme color, with discussion about whether to keep it default or custom.
evidence_quote: For the Ok/cancel button color i made a PR. But if we want to change the selected item background color as far as i know the color in the header would change also.
